name: emberline
author: Mohammad Sina Kheiri
description: Offline procedural pixel runner with strict TypeScript source

scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:browser: node --import tsx scripts/browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/gear-browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/shop-browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/coins-browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/upgrades-browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/reset-browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/expansion-browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/party-browser-check.ts && node --import tsx scripts/pwa-browser-check.ts
scripts.build:site: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/package-site.ts
scripts.host: npm run build:site && node --import tsx scripts/lan-server.ts
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
